svg.aria-label: UI/UX & product design: Understanding the people behind a problem, then designing something that fits how they actually work. Frontend & web development: Taking designs out of Figma and into real, working interfaces. User-centred, responsive design: Layouts that feel just as good on a phone as they do on a big screen. Making complicated things simple: Turning messy requirements into experiences that feel obvious.
